title: UseCaseReader
description: The Use case queries depend only on the `UseCaseReader` interface; the query runner (`answerQuery`) makes it with the definition's `reader`, `useCaseReader`, and hands it to the handler. Today's implementation, `InMemoryUseCaseReader`, reads the table the projection builds in memory on each read, so keeping the read model elsewhere is a new implementation and nothing more.
